text:
toni: hey team, joining today. trying to get a single devbox for python/node/go/rust on Intel Mac. asdf python fails during build with openssl errors. any minimalist checklist?

devex: welcome toni! :wave: minimalist checklist: brew, asdf+plugins, git, 1password, docker, direnv. For python openssl issues: brew install openssl@1.1 pkg-config and export flags.

aditya: exact snippet that worked for me on Intel MBP: 
```bash
brew install openssl@1.1 pkg-config
export LDFLAGS="-L/usr/local/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I/usr/local/opt/openssl@1.1/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/usr/local/opt/openssl@1.1/lib/pkgconfig"
asdf plugin-add python || true
asdf install python 3.11.5
```
also ensure `xcode-select --install` done.

toni: sweet. how do people handle .tool-versions and dotfiles here?

devex: prefer repo-level .tool-versions checked in. keep a personal `~/.tool-versions-local` in your dotfiles and symlink it (don't commit). dotfiles pattern: `~/dotfiles/*` with symlinks in home. add `eval "$(asdf init -)"` in your shell rc.

aditya: nodejs plugin needs gpg to verify releases. `brew install gpg` then follow asdf-nodejs docs to import keys. after node install, run `npm i -g corepack && corepack enable` if you want yarn/pnpm shims.

toni: ssh/gpg signing and agent forwarding tips?

aditya: generate ed25519 ssh key, add to github. on mac: `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. ssh config snippet: 
```bash
Host *
  AddKeysToAgent yes
  UseKeychain yes
  ForwardAgent yes
```
For git signing: generate a GPG key and set `git config --global user.signingkey <keyid>` and `git config --global commit.gpgsign true`.

devex: secrets: request access to "Redwood - Developer Secrets" vault in 1Password. local envs we usually set per-project via direnv: REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_ENV=development, REDWOOD_REGION=us-east-1. don't put secrets in dotfiles.

ops-bot: reminder: new hire onboarding step 'Request 1Password access' is pending for toni.

toni: thanks all. openssl flags fixed python build. will set up node+go next and ping if stuck. :raised_hands:
